title: Synonyms: working out and going to the gym
description: Tomás talks about working out more, they switch to a movie, then Jess brings the topic back as going to the gym. Expect the exercise talk to be one thread: the later gym segment is a revisit of the first, not a separate topic.

utterances.text: I've been working out a lot more since September. Like four times a week.
Wait, seriously? You used to make fun of me for that.
I know, I know. My doctor said my back problems were from sitting all day, so I kind of had to.
What are you doing, weights or cardio?
Mostly weights. Squats, deadlifts, rows. The back pain is basically gone already.
That's amazing. Strength training is the thing that fixed my shoulders too.
Did you see the new Villeneuve movie, by the way? I went Saturday.
Not yet! Is it good? The trailer looked incredible.
The visuals are insane. The story's a bit slow in the middle, but the last hour is so good.
I'll probably wait for the IMAX showing next week then. Was the soundtrack Zimmer again?
Yeah, and it's loud. Like, your seat shakes.
Okay, so, real question, when do you even go to the gym? You work until seven.
Six in the morning. I hated it for two weeks and now I actually like it, the gym is empty.
Six? No way. I'm barely human at six.
It helps that I go with my roommate. If one of us bails, the other one bangs on the door.
Okay, that's a good system. Maybe I need a gym buddy too, I keep skipping leg day.
Come with us Thursday. Worst case you hate it and we get breakfast after.
